name: S-exChange
source:
One day during summer vacation my junior from school came over. 
We had normal conversation. She was officially the first girl to be at my house! 
It so happens that I was minding the house myself. 
I certainly didn't mind it, but did I dare to dream what she did next......? 

Let me show you how I spent the day at home with my junior. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE153348.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假的一天，我的学弟学妹过来了。
我们进行了正常的交谈。她正式成为我家的第一个女孩！
碰巧我自己打理房子。
我当然不介意，但是我敢想象她接下来会做什么吗……？

让我告诉你我是如何和我的小弟在家里度过这一天的。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE153348.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
